Synopsis:
    Dollar holds near weekly highs amid Middle East energy supply fears, with oil above $100 driving risk-aversion flows. US PPI came in at +0.4% for August, in line with expectations. Markets are pricing a 71.1% probability of a 25bps Fed hike at the September 16 meeting, up sharply from 61.2% the prior session. 10Y Treasury yields are approaching 5%, with bond volatility rising. BOJ is expected to hike 25bps next week. Yen firmed on strong Japanese wholesale inflation data. NZD and AUD stabilizing after recent weakness.
